text:
dana-support: P0 escalation from Acme. After the v2.3 rollout (canary -> prod) their summarization outputs became shorter and include factual errors. Customer attached request examples and says this is blocking a revenue workflow. They want rollback if we can't provide a quick mitigation.

dana-support: Example from customer: "Input: long invoice thread -> Output: 'No charges found.' (wrong). Previous model returned detailed line items." They included request_id=acme-req-20260316-8a3f.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for model:redwood-v2.3 completed at 2026-03-16T02:14:12Z. 40% traffic -> 100% at 02:45Z.

ben-eng-run: ack. assigning this. @maya-sre can you confirm if any config changes (quantization, temp, decoding) went live with v2.3?

maya-sre: I see only the model binary and kernel packing change. No decode param changes in the rollout config. Quantization profile q8_auto applied in build.

eli-research: Good context. v2.3 introduced a new span-scoring head that was intended to improve brevity. Could explain truncation. We need quick A/B to compare v2.2 vs v2.3 on the customer's prompt set.

sreekar-platform: I can run a quick local eval against the customer's sample set. Share the examples.

dana-support: uploaded examples to console: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/acme/runs/2026-03-16-8a3f (internal link). Also message: customer is seeing it across multiple endpoints (chat & summarization).

ben-eng-run: Plan: 1) repro and confirm 2) if regression confirmed, revert traffic to v2.2 for Acme traffic (routing policy) or perform global rollback. Prioritize routing to avoid disruption to others.

maya-sre: I can patch route policy for customer to pin to model:v2.2 via runtime routing. Command: ```
redwoodctl routing update --customer acme --pin-model redwood-v2.2 --reason "output-regression-2026-03-16" --dry-run=false
```

ben-eng-run: +1. If we need an immediate global rollback there is a deployment rollback command: ```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service model-serving --to-version redwood-v2.2 --force --note "hotfix output regression"
```

dana-support: Customer is pushing for immediate action. They prefer a rollback if we can't provide a mitigation within 30m.

eli-research: Quick repro note: the v2.3 scoring head reduces beam diversity by default. Try setting `diversity_penalty=0.0` and `max_new_tokens=256` as an interim config to see if verboseness returns. Example curl test: ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2.3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<customer invoice text>"}],"max_new_tokens":256,"diversity_penalty":0.0}'
```

sreekar-platform: Running the customer's 6 samples now against v2.2 and v2.3. Will paste diff in 5m.

deploy-bot: rolling back route: acme -> redwood-v2.2 (pin) started by maya-sre at 2026-03-16T03:03:21Z.

maya-sre: done. Routing change confirmed: Acme traffic now served by redwood-v2.2 (edge) — verified by logs.

ben-eng-run: Great. Can support confirm customer is seeing restored behavior? Dana please escalate to account and verify.

dana-support: Reached out to customer, they're running a CI test against their workflow now. Will update in ~10m.

sreekar-platform: Results: 6/6 samples reverted to pre-rollout behavior on v2.2. v2.3 outputs are shorter and drop line items in 5/6. Repro confirmed. Attaching short diff: 
- v2.3: "No charges found."
+ v2.2: "Charges: $12.00 for service A; $3.50 tax; invoice total $15.50"

eli-research: This matches the span-scoring head hypothesis. We'll push a targeted fix (adjust span loss weight) but that will take hours. For now routing pin is the correct mitigation.

ben-eng-run: Action items: 
- maya-sre: keep Acme pinned to v2.2 and monitor for 1h.
- eli-research: prepare patch & eval on customer prompt set (ETA 4h).
- sree kar-platform: run extended batch of 1000 samples to estimate failure rate delta.
- dana-support: keep customer updated, set expectation for rollback window if needed.

maya-sre: Ack. I'll also open an incident runbook entry and tag SLO owners.

dana-support: Customer confirms initial CI checks pass with v2.2. They say "Thanks, this is urgent and we appreciate the quick pin."

ben-eng-run: We'll keep this thread active. If traffic shows reversion issues or the fix is ready earlier we'll coordinate a controlled rollout with canary gating and more conservative param defaults.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-0316-77 created, priority P0, owner ben-eng-run.

maya-sre: Closing immediate hotfix loop. Will update incident with metrics in 30m.

dana-support: Closing customer-facing loop: scheduled update at +30m.

ben-eng-run: thanks all. :heart:
